title: Fantasy Mosaic Grid
description: A 2x3 grid of stained-glass style panels featuring fantasy creatures and scenes. Visible subjects include a red squirrel, a witch flying before a glowing yellow sun, a green elephant, a green dragon, a field of orange flowers, and a purple wolf surrounded by floating eyes.
prompt: A 2x3 grid of vibrant stained-glass mosaic panels with black leading lines, each containing a different fantasy scene: top row shows a red squirrel, a witch flying on a broom in front of a bright yellow sun over red mountains, and a green elephant; bottom row shows a green dragon, a field of orange star-shaped flowers, and a purple wolf surrounded by many floating eyes, all rendered in a colorful fragmented glass art style with visible texture and speckles.
